name: wsPresence
description: Returns the presence roster for a channel — a flat built-in accessor parallel to wsPublish. The roster is a struct keyed by presence key, each value holding a metas array of the tracked metadata for that key (for example, a user's multiple tabs or devices). The channel argument is optional inside a channel handler, where it defaults to the current channel. Returns an empty struct when there is no registry or channel.

params.name: channel
params.description: The channel whose presence roster to read, e.g. "/chat". Inside a channel handler this defaults to the current channel.
